name: VR-WakerHD
alternativeNames: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD VR
searchTerms: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker VR
description: An unofficial, open-source VR version of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD, built on the ZeldaWWHDRecomp native port, with an OpenXR VR mode: first person at Link's eyes, 6DoF head tracking, motion controllers with Link's arms following them, a physical sword, a shoulder item wheel and a wrist HUD.

upstreamProject.name: ZeldaWWHDRecomp
upstreamProject.relationship: VR-WakerHD is a separate VR-focused project built on ZeldaWWHDRecomp's native port and keeps its Git history; ZeldaWWHDRecomp itself is flat-screen.

game.title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD
game.requirement: The player's own, legally obtained copy of the Wii U game; setup builds it on the player's device.

affiliation: Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Nintendo or the ZeldaWWHDRecomp authors.

platforms.name: Steam Frame (SteamOS)
platforms.status: built, not yet confirmed on the device

features: First-person view at Link's eyes with 6DoF head tracking
Third-person view with the game's camera turned by the head
Motion controllers with arm inverse kinematics
Physical sword with swing attacks and hit vibration
Lock-on, automatic parry and shield guard
Motion-controlled bow, Skull Hammer and Wind Waker baton
Menus, dialogue and the GamePad screen on panels in the headset
Multiview stereo rendering and foveated rendering on Quest
Dynamic resolution, upscaling and frame synthesis
